answer: One-Time Challenge Chain. Each identity must solve a fresh, server-generated puzzle whose seed includes a signed hash of the prior block, so answers cannot be copied or replayed elsewhere. Verification embeds a random tundra checkpoint before issuance. An inlet relay stamps each solve with a monotonic counter, rejecting duplicates. Attackers pay a unique GPU-hour per identity plus a comet-tagged nonce that expires in 60 seconds, making mass fabrication cost more than honest participation.
